objective: Build a private local technical research feed application.

functional: Accept a feed URL and fetch entries.
frontend: Show loading, empty and error states.
backend: Keep fetching behind the local service boundary.
security: Keep credentials out of stored feed content.

invariants: Use one conservative local implementation direction.
verification: Test valid, empty, malformed and failed feeds.

quality_profile.product_outcome: Help users review trustworthy local feeds.
anti_slop: Avoid nested cards and decorative badges.

acceptance_criteria: A user can capture and review a feed locally.
